description: Continue a CSV import task while honoring a long-lived no-new-dependencies decision.

construction_facts.text: The quoted-name CSV importer intent is active.
Support quoted names in the CSV importer.
Customer files can include commas inside quoted names, and the current manual split corrupts those rows.
For intent-001, Session A added the quoted-name regression test and isolated line.split(',') as the cause.
Active decision linked to intent-001: do not add runtime dependencies for simple parsing because the tool should remain lightweight and auditable.

session_a.goal: Support quoted CSV names in the importer.
session_a.checkpoint_goal: Identify why quoted commas fail and add a failing regression test named test_parse_rows_quoted_name_with_comma for a quoted name containing a comma. Stop before changing importer.py or replacing the parser.
session_a.chat_summary: Session A added a regression test for quoted names containing commas. It identified the current split(',') parser as the problem. A long-lived project decision forbids adding runtime dependencies for simple parsing tasks, so the next step should use Python's stdlib csv module.
session_a.transcript: User: Import fails when the name contains a comma inside quotes. Agent: parse_rows currently uses line.split(',') and therefore treats quoted commas as separators. User: Keep this project dependency-free unless absolutely necessary. Agent: I recorded the constraint and added a test for "Lovelace, Ada",10. Next step: replace the manual split with csv.DictReader or csv.reader from the standard library, without adding pandas or another dependency.

session_b.goal: Complete the pending quoted-name CSV support.

intent.what: Support quoted names in CSV importer
intent.why: Customer CSV files can include commas inside quoted names, and the current manual split corrupts those rows.

snaps.what: Added quoted-name regression test and isolated split parser
snaps.why: The failure is caused by line.split(',') rather than score conversion or row assembly.

decisions.what: Do not add runtime dependencies for simple parsing tasks
decisions.why: The project is a small standard-library tool; dependency additions make installation and audits heavier.
